active research program

Attention Windowing

measuring exactly how much of attention is slack, per head and causally, then deploying that measurement into zero-retraining inference compression.

the premise

replace one attention head with a fixed sink-plus-local window, renormalize, and read off the perplexity cost: this gives a causal, per-head map of how load-bearing each head is. across GPT-2, Pythia, and Qwen (124M to 7.6B), 81% to 99.9% of heads come back near-free to window.

when windowing whole KV groups on Qwen2.5-7B at runtime with exact FlexAttention kernels, this delivers a direct three-axis Pareto win:

windowed heads perplexity Δ attention speedup KV cache saved fine-tuning
25% of groups lossless (0.00) ~1.5× 1.33× none (zero-shot)
50% of groups lossless Qwen / +0.22 Llama ~1.9 – 2.2× 1.99× none (zero-shot)
75% of groups +0.50 … +0.96 ~3.8× 3.97× healing-gated

research threads

The Compressibility Map framework

the diagnostic instrument. replace one attention head with a fixed sink-plus-local window, renormalize, and read off the perplexity cost. locality predicts compressibility, and GQA does not consume this headroom.

The Realization: Three-Axis Pareto active

deploying the map end-to-end on Qwen2.5-7B: window whole KV groups at runtime with FlexAttention. 50% KV reduction and ~2× speedup with zero fine-tuning required.

Retrieval Survival (Passkey Testing) active

passkey needle-in-a-haystack test evaluating whether the perplexity-expensive heads the map preserves are the exact heads retrieval needs.

The Edge Stack blueprint

windowing is orthogonal to 4-bit weight quantization: 4-bit weights + 50% windowed KV groups allows 8B models to run long context on commodity edge devices.
